intended_object: For a subgroupoid S of a groupoid C and an object c of S, the vertex (isotropy) subgroup S(c,c) of the vertex group Aut(c) = (c ⟶ c). Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The carrier is S.arrows c c. Closure under composition and under inverses come from the subgroupoid axioms S.mul and S.inv. The identity lies in the carrier because c ∈ S.objs means S.arrows c c is nonempty, and then f ≫ f⁻¹ = 𝟙 c (lemma id_mem_of_nonempty_isotropy). So this is the standard vertex subgroup of a subgroupoid at one of its objects. It is stated for an arbitrary groupoid, which is the natural generality.
